title: Prescribed-order subdigraphs with large minimum out-degree
summary: Alon introduced $d(s)$ as the largest integer $d$ such that every digraph on $2n$ vertices with minimum out-degree at least $s$ contains a subdigraph on $n$ vertices with minimum out-degree at least $d$. He proved that $s/2-d(s)=O(\sqrt{s\log s})$, and further asked whether this deficit can be bounded by an absolute constant. Steiner answered this question in the negative by constructing suitable tournaments, and showed that $s/2-d(s)=Ω(\log s)$.
